subject: Re: Scheduling HQ demo — preferred slots, NDA, and waitlist
body:
From: Emma Jackson <emma.jackson@novacorp.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: sales_ops@novacorp.com
Date: Sun, 10 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HQ demo — availability and NDA

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the quick response. We are excited to come by Redwood HQ for a product walk-through focused on latency and cost controls for our search assistant POC. Our execs are available for an onsite between Oct 18–21; the team prefers mornings (9:00–11:30 PT). We understand capacity is limited and are OK with a shorter 45–60 minute slot if needed.

Two asks from our side:
- Can we confirm an NDA quickly? I attached the standard NovaCorp mutual NDA (we can sign Redwood's version if you prefer).
- If the 18–21 window is full, please add us to a waitlist and let us know any earlier morning options.

Emma Jackson
Director, ML Platforms | NovaCorp
emma.jackson@novacorp.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: NovaCorp_NDA_v1.pdf (PDF)

----------
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jackson <emma.jackson@novacorp.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 10 Oct 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HQ demo — availability and NDA

Emma — great to hear, and thanks for the NDA. Quick note on timing: our exec-runner slots that week are nearly full because we have two customer immersions, but we should be able to get you in.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’m attaching our mutual NDA (Redwood_NDA_v2.pdf) — please sign via DocuSign and I’ll countersign the same day.
2) Can you confirm the names and roles of the attendees (so we can pull the right team)?
3) If you’re flexible on the 60-minute length, we can guarantee a 45-minute exec slot on Oct 19 at 09:00 PT; otherwise I’ll put you on the waitlist and notify you if anything opens up earlier.

I’ll loop in Karthik to check room availability and logistics.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
(415) 555-2088

Attachment: Redwood_NDA_v2.pdf (PDF)

----------
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 10 Oct 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HQ demo — availability and NDA

Laura — checking room inventory and AV. Quick facts:
- Exec suite (Room E2) is booked Oct 18 AM and Oct 20 all day.
- Conference room C1 (video + 2x projector) is free Oct 19 08:30–12:00.
- We have a backup huddle room (B3) with overflow seating and streaming on standby.

If we commit to Oct 19 09:00 PT we should reserve C1 and request a streaming link for remote participants. Also recommend sending the attendee list (names + titles) to security for visitor passes.

Karthik
Technical Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference

----------
From: Emma Jackson <emma.jackson@novacorp.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: sales_ops@novacorp.com
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HQ demo — availability and NDA

Laura — appreciate the fast turnaround. Two quick confirmations:
- Oct 19 at 09:00 PT works for us for a 45–60 min slot.
- Attendees: Emma Jackson (Director, ML Platforms), Raj Patel (Engineering Lead), Sophie Lin (Product Owner).

We signed and attached our copy of the NovaCorp NDA; please countersign and send back. Also, can you confirm parking and badge pickup? Evening arrival for two of our engineers is possible (they fly red-eye).

Emma

Attachment: NovaCorp_NDA_signed.pdf (PDF)

----------
From: monica_patel@redwood.com <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Emma Jackson <emma.jackson@novacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 07:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HQ demo — availability and NDA

Emma — thank you. Laura — I’ve provisionally reserved Conference C1 for Oct 19 08:30–10:15 PT and requested visitor passes for the three attendees.

Logistics (quick):
- Parking: Red lot A (visitor stalls) — leave license plate numbers and security will issue a temporary pass at the gate.
- Badge pickup: Lobby desk between 08:00–08:30. Bring government ID.
- AV: Projector + mic + streaming link have been scheduled; I’ll email the RT link by end of day Oct 17.
- Catering: We can do a coffee + light breakfast for 08:45; confirm any dietary restrictions by Oct 15.

I’ve also uploaded the visit checklist to the shared drive and attached the site-visit checklist.

Attachment: site-visit-checklist.xlsx (XLSX)

Monica Patel
Customer Success Ops | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

----------
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jackson <emma.jackson@novacorp.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 16:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HQ demo — availability and NDA

All set — thanks everyone.

Emma — I countersigned the Redwood NDA and sent the DocuSign envelope (link below). Once DocuSign confirms we’ll send a calendar invitation for Oct 19 09:00–09:50 PT and the visitor pass confirmation.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/embedded?env=prod&doc=NB-2027-045-NDA
Calendar placeholder: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=demo-novacorp-20271019

If your folks need an earlier arrival window to run through connectivity, Karthik can be onsite at 08:15 to help stage laptops.

Looking forward to hosting you — safe travels.

Laura

Attachment: Countersigned_Redwood_NDA.pdf (PDF)
